items.question: What is No Barriers, No Excuses?
items.answer: A community-driven movement within triathlon that works to reduce bias, increase access, and create fairer environments for all athletes. We unite volunteers, ambassadors, clubs, coaches and decision-makers to make the sport more inclusive from the ground up.

items.question: Is this only for people who experience discrimination?
items.answer: No. The webinar is open to anyone in or around triathlon — athletes, coaches, technical officials, federation staff, volunteers and allies. If you want a fairer sport, you belong in the room.

items.question: Does it cost anything?
items.answer: No. The webinar is free and runs online. You just need to register so we can send you the joining link.

items.question: Will it be recorded?
items.answer: Yes. If you register but can't make it live, we'll send you the recording and the resources afterwards.

items.question: What is the 24 November roundtable?
items.answer: A smaller, hands-on follow-up session a week later — all about networking, bridging, and finding shared communities. You can opt in when you register for the webinar.
